quirks.summary: File GETs are session-gated, not Referer-gated.
quirks.detail: With a JSESSIONID and no Referer a file GET returns the PDF; a cold jar, or a Referer with no session, returns HTTP 404 with an HTML body served under the .pdf filename.
quirks.workaround: Carry the search session's cookie jar through to every file GET.

quirks.summary: Document filenames are pre-normalised to REF-DESC-serial.pdf, so the files are self-labelling.
quirks.detail: Files are served under names built from the application reference, the document description and a serial, so a label need not be scraped from the documents tab.

source_notes:
Clean Idox, standard base path — Recipe C applies verbatim. FILE GETS ARE SESSION-GATED, NOT REFERER-GATED: with JSESSIONID but no Referer -> 200 PDF; cold or Referer-only -> HTTP 404 serving HTML under the .pdf name. _csrf is lowercase-UUID. Exact-ref search returns a one-row results list. No WAF (plain Apache+JBoss; JSESSIONID node-suffixed .gcwgnclidxl01). Idox pre-normalises doc filenames (REF-DESC-serial.pdf) — self-labelling. PlanIt docs_url/keyVal/n_documents all accurate.

Largest Scottish LPA.
